name: CoorNut
comment: Returns the side elevation of a nut centered on the origin. Argument order is width, thickness, then optional isRepeatFirstPoint. Each corner is chamfered by width/8 horizontally and at 30 degrees. Vertex order starts at the upper-left end of the top flat and runs clockwise. isRepeatFirstPoint defaults to FALSE; TRUE appends the first vertex again. Non-numeric sizes return #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
